description: A delay with a send and return around its repeats, so another effect can be put inside the feedback path

params.text: Sets the delay, 0 to 10 seconds, read out in milliseconds on the display
Sets how much of each repeat is fed back for the next one, silence to full
Filters the repeats: below the middle a lowpass closes down on them, above it a highpass opens up
Crossfades between the incoming signal and the repeats
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

inputs.text: Added to the TIME knob, a second per volt
Added to the FDBK knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the COLOR knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
The point where the treated repeats come back in; with the SND output patched and this jack unpatched the repeats and the feedback both fall silent
Added to the MIX knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
The signal that goes into the delay
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back

outputs.text: Each repeat before it is fed back, for another effect to work on
The delayed signal blended with the incoming one

notes: Patching the SND output takes the COLOR filter out of the circuit: the repeats leave at SND and come back in at RTN, and the RTN jack is what feeds the delay line again.

inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
